basicAuth.description: Basic Authentication using API credentials (token_key:token_secret). Used for scoped API endpoints under /api/v1/api/*

bearerAuth.name: Authorization
bearerAuth.description: JWT Bearer token authentication. Format: 'Bearer <token>'. Used for dashboard endpoints.

get.description: Retrieve all techniques. By default, deduplicates by name (latest version only). Use all_versions=true to return every version. Requires JWT auth.

parameters.name: all_versions
parameters.description: When true, return all versions instead of deduplicating

post.description: Create a new configuration technique with methods. Returns 409 if name+version already exists. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: Retrieve a single technique with its enabled directives. Requires JWT auth.

put.description: Update a technique. If the version field changes, a NEW row is created (old version preserved for pinned directives). Returns new_version:true and previous_id when versioned. Requires JWT auth.

delete.description: Delete a technique by ID. Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: List all versions of a technique
get.description: List all versions of a technique (matched by name). Returns version history with directive counts. Requires JWT auth.
Retrieve directives with optional filtering. Includes linked technique info. Requires JWT auth.

post.description: Create a directive from a technique. Auto-pins to the technique current version. Requires JWT auth.

description.example: Creates the deploy user on all servers

get.description: Retrieve a single directive with its technique and linked rules. Requires JWT auth.

put.description: Update directive fields. Can switch technique or pin a specific technique version. Requires JWT auth.

delete.description: Delete a directive by ID. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: Retrieve all rules with linked directives and groups. Ordered by priority then name. Requires JWT auth.

post.description: Create a rule linking directives to host groups. Supports schedule types: always, once, interval, cron. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: Retrieve a single rule with full directive+technique details and groups. Requires JWT auth.

put.description: Update rule fields. Replaces directive and group links atomically when provided. Requires JWT auth.

delete.description: Delete a rule by ID. Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: Get computed policy for a host
get.description: Compute and return the full resolved policy for a host. Resolves rules → directives → techniques based on host group memberships. Returns null if no applicable rules. Requires JWT auth.

Agent fetches its computed config management policy. Supports hash-based caching: pass the SHA-256 hash of the last received policy as ?hash= to skip re-download if unchanged. Checks configmanagement_enabled flag. Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers.

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: SHA-256 hash of last received policy (for cache check)

post.description: Agent submits a compliance report after evaluating its policy. Stores a cm_policy_runs row. Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers.

get.description: List recent policy compliance runs with pagination. Includes host info. Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: Get a compliance run by ID
get.description: Retrieve a specific compliance run with full details including host info. Requires JWT auth.
Overview stats: technique/directive/rule/host counts, recent runs, average score over last 24h. Requires JWT auth.
Full pipeline diagnostic: checks techniques, directives, rules, enabled hosts, policy applicability, agent contact recency, and agent version. Returns issues and details. Requires JWT auth.

post.description: Compute policy for a host and generate a cm_policy_runs entry with all directives marked not_evaluated/not_applicable. Useful for testing the pipeline without an agent. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: Retrieve all patch policies with linked groups, filters, window/job counts, and computed host_count. Requires JWT auth.

post.description: Create a new patch policy with optional group and filter links. Returns 409 on duplicate name. Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: Get a patch policy by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single policy with groups, filters, windows, recent jobs, and per-host updatable package counts. Requires JWT auth.

put.description: Update policy fields. If group_ids or filters provided, replaces all links atomically. Returns 409 on duplicate name. Requires JWT auth.

delete.description: Delete a patch policy by ID. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: List all maintenance windows with policy name and job count. Ordered by next_run_at. Requires JWT auth.

post.description: Create a maintenance window for a policy. Computes next_run_at from cron expression. Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: Get a maintenance window by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single window with policy name and last 20 jobs. Requires JWT auth.

put.description: Update window fields. Recomputes next_run_at from cron. Requires JWT auth.

delete.description: Delete a maintenance window by ID. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: List patch jobs with filtering and pagination. Includes policy/window names and host count. Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: Get a patch job by ID
get.description: Retrieve a single job with policy details, window, and all patch_job_hosts with per-package results. Requires JWT auth.
Get before/after snapshot diff for a specific host in a patch job. Requires JWT auth.

post.description: Manually trigger a new patch job for a policy. Creates the job and enqueues hosts. Requires JWT auth.
Cancel a pending or running job. Marks job as cancelled and skips all pending hosts. Requires JWT auth.

get.description: Overview statistics: policy/window counts, pending/running jobs, 5 most recent jobs, 5 upcoming windows, job status breakdown for last 30 days. Requires JWT auth.
Full job history with pagination and per-host details (status, packages updated/failed). Requires JWT auth.

get.summary: Agent: check for pending patch job
get.description: Agent checks if it has a pending patch job to execute. Returns has_job:true with job details or has_job:false. Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers.

post.description: Agent submits patch execution results. Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers.
Agent updates its job-host status. Body: job_host_id, status. If first host starts, marks parent job as running. Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers.

put.description: Agent updates its job-host status (alias for POST). Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers.

post.description: Agent submits a batch of recent log entries for storage and UI viewing. Authenticated via X-API-ID/X-API-KEY headers. Max 500 entries per batch.

get.summary: Get agent logs for a host
get.description: Retrieve agent log entries for a specific host with filtering by level, source, time range, and search text. Supports pagination. Requires JWT auth.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Filter by log level (debug, info, warn, error). Comma-separated for multiple.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Filter by source module (e.g. configmanagement). Comma-separated for multiple.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - only entries after this time

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: ISO 8601 timestamp - only entries before this time

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort order: desc (newest first, default) or asc

delete.description: Delete all log entries for a specific host. Optionally filter by age. Requires JWT auth.

parameters.name: older_than
parameters.description: Delete only entries older than this ISO 8601 timestamp

get.summary: Get log source modules for a host
get.description: Returns distinct source modules that have produced log entries for this host. Useful for populating filter dropdowns.

get.summary: Get log statistics for a host
get.description: Returns counts per level, date range, and total entries for a host. Requires JWT auth.
